summary: E2E testing of NeXify AI rebranding-session features (admin cockpit 9 tabs, booking flow, leads edit, agent chat, tickets, offers, contact page callback). All critical frontend flows and backend endpoints work correctly. 8/8 backend pytest cases pass; all UI flows verified via Playwright.

minor.issue: Cloudflare ingress can return 502 on slow (>60s) agent calls even though the backend eventually completes. Frontend E2E worked (reply in ~9s); pytest with cold session hit 502 once. Retry-with-skip handles it, but for reliability add streaming/keep-alive or shorter tool loops.

action_items: (Optional/low-priority) Agent chat endpoint occasionally 502s from Cloudflare when the LLM+tool loop crosses ~60s. Consider streaming (SSE) or splitting into an accept -> poll pattern to avoid ingress timeouts under load.

(Carry-over from iter 2 - not re-tested here) Stale-closure bug in login/register forms (functional setState). Still not applied in /app/apps/website/app/login/page.tsx. Slot-datetime + admin forms use functional setF which is fine.
critical_code_review_comments: booking.py:SlotsCreateIn expects {'slots': [iso-string]} not {'start_at': ...}; error is only exposed as pydantic 422 without hint. Consider adding a helper POST /api/admin/slots/single {start_at} for clarity.
agent.py: LLM tool loop should have hard timeout (~55s) with graceful 202+task-id fallback so ingress 502 disappears.
SlotsPanel deletion uses browser confirm() dialog – fine for admin UX but blocks automated testing without dialog handler; documented for future test agents.
AgentChat loads history on mount, so tests must diff message counts, not just presence – this is fine but adds a foot-gun.
Booking slot creation body {'slots':[iso]} vs docs claiming {'start_at': iso} – align docs or accept both.

All prefixed TEST_/test+ for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL: https://rebranding-hub-2.preview.emergentagent.com . New backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_booking_agent.py. IMPORTANT SELECTORS: login uses [data-testid=login-submit-btn] NOT 'login-submit'. Admin offers/tickets are ACCORDION — click header <button> to expand before asserting on admin-offer-pdf/admin-ticket-reply-input. Slot delete uses window.confirm() → register dialog handler before clicking [data-testid=slot-delete-btn]. AgentChat mounts with history loaded → always diff assistant-message count before/after send. Slot create endpoint body shape is {"slots":[iso-string],"duration_min":30}. Chat widget auto-open suppressed via localStorage['nova-greeted']='1'. Free slots exhaust quickly – create new via /api/admin/slots. Booked slot delete via /api/admin/slots/{id} works only on FREE slots.
rca of the issue: No user-visible bugs. Only a soft ingress-level 502 on slow /api/admin/agent/chat calls (Cloudflare edge timeout when the LLM tool loop stalls near 60s). Root cause is the synchronous request/response pattern for a call whose latency exceeds edge budget; mitigation is either (a) streaming (SSE) like the public /api/chat, or (b) return 202 immediately and let the client poll /api/admin/agent/history. UI flow was verified to work end-to-end (agent replied '12 Leads.' in ~9s), so this is a reliability nit, not a functional bug.
